name: Conversation Archive
description: Archives gateway-seen messages into workspace-local JSONL logs and bundles a skill for later history retrieval.

archiveRoot.description: Relative canonical message archive path under each workspace. Defaults to logs/message-archive-raw.

eventArchiveRoot.description: Relative event log path under each workspace for gateway/pipeline stage records. Defaults to logs/message-archive-events.

warnOnUnsupportedChannels.description: Warn once when a channel is not yet mapped into the archive format.
